The following events took place in '''27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*First [[YVH 1]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[YVH 1-1A]], was released.
*[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|fell]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], resulting in the establishment of the new [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] dominate [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]].
*The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] moved to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].
*[[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka Chume Ta'Djo]] became [[Queen Mother]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]].
*The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] declared a state of [[ar'krai]] for the first time in millennia.
*The ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' was destroyed.
*The [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] were both destroyed.
*The [[Jedi Headquarters]] were destroyed, revealing the ruins of the old [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
